## Load data

```{r load}
data_dir <- "../../all_cells_final_data"

counts <- open_matrix_dir(file.path(data_dir, "final.counts.disk.new.int"))

meta <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "meta.new.rds/meta.new.rds"))

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts   = counts,
  meta.data = meta
)

obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
```

```{r}
table(obj$GEO.Cohort)
```

## Load pre-computed UMAP

```{r load_umap}
umap_coords <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "full.umap.new.csv"),
  row.names = 1
)

# Subset to cells present in both obj and the UMAP
shared_cells <- intersect(colnames(obj), rownames(umap_coords))
cat("Cells in obj:        ", ncol(obj), "\n")
cat("Cells in UMAP file:  ", nrow(umap_coords), "\n")
cat("Shared cells:        ", length(shared_cells), "\n")

obj <- obj[, shared_cells]

umap_mat <- as.matrix(umap_coords[shared_cells, ])
colnames(umap_mat) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

obj[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = umap_mat,
  key        = "UMAP_",
  assay      = DefaultAssay(obj)
)
saveRDS(obj,     "results/obj.fig1.rds")
```

```{r}
obj <- readRDS("results/obj.fig1.rds")
table(obj$celltype)
```

```{r umap_celltype}
# shared celltype palette: reproduces Seurat/ggplot default hues, applied explicitly
# here and in the composition bar so each celltype keeps one color across panels
celltype_cols <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(nlevels(factor(obj$celltype))),
                          levels(factor(obj$celltype)))

DimPlot(obj, group.by = "celltype", label = T, pt.size = 1, alpha = .5, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(1024, 1024), cols = celltype_cols) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle(NULL)
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.celltype.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, dpi = 600)

DimPlot(obj, group.by = "celltype", label = F, pt.size = 1.4, alpha = .6, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(4096, 4096), cols = celltype_cols) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 1)
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.celltype.png", height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")

dx_cols <- c(HC = "#59A14F", BID = "#B07AA1", CTCL = "#E15759")  # softened Set1 (Tableau-style) to blend with Seurat default hues
obj$Dx.simple <- factor(as.character(obj$Dx.simple), levels = c("HC", "BID", "CTCL"))

void_umap <- theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 1)

p1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "orig.ident", label = F, pt.size = 1.4, alpha = .6, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(2048, 2048), shuffle = T) +
  void_umap
p2 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", label = F, pt.size = 1.4, alpha = .6, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(2048, 2048), shuffle = T) +
  void_umap
p3 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "Dx.simple", label = F, pt.size = 1.4, alpha = .6, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(2048, 2048), shuffle = T) +
  scale_color_manual(values = dx_cols) +
  void_umap
p4 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "cloneSize", label = F, pt.size = 1.4, alpha = .6, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(2048, 2048), shuffle = T) +
  void_umap

ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.orig.ident.png", plot = p1, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.geo.cohort.png",  plot = p2, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.dx.simple.png",   plot = p3, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.clonesize.png",   plot = p4, height = 6, width = 6, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")

grid <- (p1 | p3) / (p2 | p4)
grid
#ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.grid.pdf", plot = grid, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)
ggsave("figs/umap.all.cells.grid.png", plot = grid, height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
```

```{r deg_dotplot}
Idents(obj) <- "celltype"
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.5,
                          test.use = "wilcox", verbose = FALSE)
markers$dif <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct2

markers <- readRDS("results/markers.celltype.all.rds")

ct_levels <- sort(unique(obj$celltype))
obj$celltype <- factor(obj$celltype, levels = ct_levels)

top3 <- markers %>%
  filter(cluster %in% ct_levels, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = ct_levels)) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(score = rank(-avg_log2FC) + rank(-dif)) %>%   # combined rank: lower = better on both magnitude & specificity
  slice_min(score, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

DotPlot(obj, features = rev(top3), group.by = "celltype", dot.scale = 6) +
  coord_flip() +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8))
ggsave("figs/dotplot.celltype.top3markers.pdf", height = 7, width = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r celltype_proportions}
prop_df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(orig.merge, celltype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(orig.merge) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

sample_meta <- obj@meta.data %>%
  select(orig.merge, Tissue) %>%
  distinct()

tissue_order <- c("blood", "lymph node", "skin")

tcell_prop <- prop_df %>%
  filter(celltype == "T_Cells") %>%
  select(orig.merge, tcell_prop = prop)

sample_order <- sample_meta %>%
  left_join(tcell_prop, by = "orig.merge") %>%
  mutate(Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels = tissue_order)) %>%
  arrange(Tissue, tcell_prop) %>%
  pull(orig.merge)

# stack T_Cells against the x-axis so the T-cell gradient (sample ordering) reads cleanly
ct_stack_levels <- c(setdiff(sort(unique(prop_df$celltype)), "T_Cells"), "T_Cells")

prop_df <- prop_df %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "orig.merge") %>%
  mutate(orig.merge = factor(orig.merge, levels = sample_order),
         Tissue = factor(Tissue, levels = tissue_order),
         celltype = factor(celltype, levels = ct_stack_levels))

library(patchwork)

# Tissue palette: fig3 scheme (blood=red, lymph node=green, skin=blue) softened
# (Tableau-style) to sit with the Seurat default hues
tissue_cols <- c("blood" = "#E15759", "lymph node" = "#59A14F", "skin" = "#4E79A7")

# labeled Tissue annotation strip, sharing the bar's faceting/ordering
anno_df <- prop_df %>% distinct(orig.merge, Tissue)

p_anno <- ggplot(anno_df, aes(x = orig.merge, y = 1, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  facet_grid(~ Tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tissue_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(strip.text       = element_blank(),
        strip.background  = element_blank(),
        legend.position   = "none",
        panel.spacing     = unit(0, "lines"))

p_bar <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = orig.merge, y = prop, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +   # <1 leaves a gap between samples; no border = no lines between celltypes
  facet_grid(~ Tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cell type proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x   = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text    = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"))

p_anno / p_bar + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 22))
ggsave("figs/barplot.celltype.proportions.pdf", height = 4.3, width = 11, dpi = 600)
```

```{r tcr_purity}
tcr_cells <- meta %>% filter(!is.na(cloneSize))
pct_tcell <- mean(tcr_cells$celltype == "T_Cells") * 100
cat(sprintf("%.1f%% of TCR+ cells are labeled T_Cells (%d / %d)\n",
            pct_tcell, sum(tcr_cells$celltype == "T_Cells"), nrow(tcr_cells)))

pct_hyper <- mean(tcr_cells$cloneSize == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)") * 100
cat(sprintf("%.1f%% of TCR+ cells are Hyperexpanded (%d / %d)\n",
            pct_hyper, sum(tcr_cells$cloneSize == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"), nrow(tcr_cells)))
```


```{r tcr_paired_samples}
# samples (orig.ident) with paired TCR-seq: at least one cell with a called clonotype
meta <- obj@meta.data
n_tcr_samples   <- meta %>% filter(!is.na(cloneSize)) %>% distinct(orig.ident) %>% nrow()
n_total_samples <- meta %>% distinct(orig.ident) %>% nrow()
cat(sprintf("%d / %d samples (orig.ident) have paired TCR-seq data\n",
            n_tcr_samples, n_total_samples))
```
